technical_and_design_decisions: Use Spring Cloud Config Server for centralized property management in spring-bus modules.
Implement Apache Ambari plugin support for Spring XD on YARN using Ambari's stack and service extension model.
Use Hadoop LocalFileSystem when fsUri is set to file:// for single-node setups.
Pass system properties to Sqoop jobs via command-line arguments in a separate Java process.
Profile SI 4.2 channels using Spring Integration performance monitoring tools.
Measure serialization performance in XD using benchmarking tools like JMH.
Upgrade Spring XD from 1.2 RC to 1.2 GA by updating dependencies and verifying compatibility.
Review spring-bus architecture using existing design documents and codebase analysis.
assumptions: Developer has prior experience with Spring ecosystem, YARN, and Ambari plugin development.
Existing documentation and design specs for spring-bus are available for review.
Ambari plugin development follows standard Ambari service extension patterns.
Performance profiling tools and environments are already set up.
Hadoop cluster access is available for testing LocalFileSystem functionality.
Sqoop job execution environment supports passing system properties via command line.
All required dependencies and libraries are accessible for upgrade tasks.
